verses.text: For the music director. A psalm of David. May the LORD answer you when you are in trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob protect you.
May he send you help from his holy place and support you from Zion.
May he remember all your offerings and accept your burnt sacrifices. Selah.
May he give you what your heart wants and make all your plans succeed.
We will shout for joy when you win. We will raise our flags in the name of our God. May the LORD give you everything you ask for.
Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed king. He answers him from his holy heaven with the saving power of his right hand.
Some people trust in chariots and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
They are brought to their knees and fall, but we rise up and stand firm.
LORD, save the king! Answer us when we call!
